description: This file contains helper functions for handling batch dimensions, reshaping, and validation checks used in the context of batch operations within PyTorch's functorch module. It provides utilities for moving batch dimensions, computing tensor ranks and sizes ignoring batch dimensions, and checking randomness constraints in batched computations.

methods.name: Tensor moveBatchDimToFront(Tensor tensor,std::optional<int64_t> maybe_batch_dim)
methods.description: Moves the specified batch dimension of the tensor to the front (dimension 0) if a batch dimension exists; otherwise returns the tensor unchanged.

methods.name: int64_t rankWithoutBatchDim(const Tensor & tensor,std::optional<int64_t> maybe_batch_dim)
methods.description: Returns the tensor's rank (number of dimensions) minus one if a batch dimension is specified; otherwise, returns the tensor's full rank.

methods.name: int64_t numelWithoutBatchDim(const Tensor & tensor,std::optional<int64_t> maybe_batch_dim)
methods.description: Computes the number of elements in the tensor ignoring the batch dimension if specified.

methods.name: std::optional<int64_t> valIfNonempty(std::optional<int64_t> maybe_empty,int64_t new_val)
methods.description: Returns the new value if the optional is set; otherwise returns nullopt.

methods.name: int64_t getPhysicalDim(const Tensor & tensor,bool has_batch_dim,int64_t logical_dim)
methods.description: Calculates the physical dimension index in the tensor corresponding to a logical dimension, considering whether a batch dimension is present.

methods.name: VmapDimVector getPhysicalDims(const Tensor & tensor,bool has_batch_dim,IntArrayRef logical_dims)
methods.description: Computes the physical dimension indices for multiple logical dimensions, considering batch dimension presence.

methods.name: Tensor maybePadToLogicalRank(const Tensor & tensor,std::optional<int64_t> has_bdim,int64_t logical_rank)
methods.description: Pads the tensor with singleton dimensions so that its logical rank matches the specified rank, considering batch dimension presence.

methods.name: void check_randomness(RandomnessType randomness)
methods.description: Checks the correctness of randomness flags, raising errors if invalid conditions are detected.

methods.name: Tensor reshape_dim_into(int64_t src,int64_t dst,const Tensor & x)
methods.description: Reshapes the tensor by moving a dimension into another position, combining the two dimensions.

methods.name: Tensor reshape_dim_outof(int64_t src,int64_t size1,const Tensor & x)
methods.description: Reshapes the tensor by splitting a dimension into two, specified by the new size.

methods.name: Tensor reshape_dim_outof_symint(int64_t src,const c10::SymInt & size1,const Tensor & x)
methods.description: Same as above but handles symbolic integers (SymInt).

methods.name: void vmapIncompatibleInplaceError(const char * schema_name)
methods.description: Raises an error for in-place operations that are incompatible with vmap semantics.

methods.name: std::tuple<Tensor,Tensor> _binary_pointwise_helper(const Tensor & tensor,std::optional<int64_t> tensor_batch_dim,const Tensor & other,std::optional<int64_t> other_batch_dim,bool do_type_promotion)
methods.description: Prepares two tensors for binary pointwise operations, handling batch dimensions, type promotion, and broadcasting.
